name: Apnea-ECG Database: Obstructive Sleep Apnea Detection Benchmark
description: The Apnea-ECG Database is a foundational physiological signal benchmark developed for the Computers in Cardiology Challenge 2000 and hosted on PhysioNet. Contributed by Philipps University Marburg in Germany, the collection contains 70 overnight single-lead ECG recordings (approx 7 to 10 hours each) digitized at 100 Hz. The dataset is divided into a 35-recording training set and a 35-recording test set. Accompanied by synchronized continuous respiration signals for a subset of recordings, each recording features expert minute-by-minute annotations indicating the presence or absence of sleep apnea, enabling research into automated detection of obstructive sleep apnea from single-lead electrocardiograms.
